I cancelled the most recent Google import, job `job_3694d3a7f4df`, and confirmed it has stopped. Its status is now `cancelled` and it has a `finished_at` time.

The job was importing the activity category for Oct 1–3, 2026. It had finished 4 of 18 requests before it was stopped, and it was waiting on a provider rate limit at the time. Because it stopped before writing any records, the import added nothing to your local data: inserted, updated and restored counts are all zero.

If you want the rest of this range, `resume_job` can continue it. Completed requests are kept, and failed ones are retried.
